coverage_assessment: Seventeen recorded open-web search batches (three tool invocations bundled multiple probes) include French/English general and weekly windows, teachers/SET, health, agriculture, opposition, regional/city and student probes, explicit Ewe/Eʋegbe and Kabiyè/Kabiye terms, and December–January Lomé University continuity. One actual school sit-in/strike report remains a pending-threshold candidate; turnout and exact chronology are unresolved. Two exclusions preserve an internal union-office meeting and later announced strike dates without verified public execution. One November university cessation is an unverified cross-month lead. Coverage and language remain uneven; no fixed number of searches establishes completeness.
